blocks.text: This page tracks the Abbotsford MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $701,900 for a typical home, down 9.0% over twelve months.
Abbotsford benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Abbotsford home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $701,900 in September 2026. That is down 1.6% on the month, down 4.9% over three months, down 6.1% over six months and down 9.0% over the year. Over three years it is down 12.7%, and over five years down 11.0%.
The weakest one-year move in Abbotsford was for a detached home homes at −11.1%; the strongest was a townhouse at −8.6%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,087,000) and an apartment ($370,200) is $716,800, and a townhouse ($592,600) sits $222,400 above the apartment benchmark.
Against the Fraser Valley Board area, where the all-home benchmark was $861,300, Abbotsford is 18.5% below. Over the year the Fraser Valley Board area moved down 7.2% against down 9.0% here.
Of the 8 areas this board reports, Abbotsford ranks 7 by all-home benchmark, with Mission above it at $797,500 and North Surrey below it at $639,100.

Detached homes in Abbotsford: benchmark $1,087,000, down 2.7% in a month, down 7.3% in three months, down 8.6% in six months, down 11.1% in a year, down 9.7% in three years and down 9.5% in five. That is 16.4% below the detached benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($1,300,000).

Townhouse homes in Abbotsford: benchmark $592,600, little changed at −0.7% in a month, down 2.3% in three months, down 5.1% in six months, down 8.6% in a year, down 9.1% in three years and little changed at −0.5% in five. That is 20.5% below the townhouse benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($745,300).

Apartment homes in Abbotsford: benchmark $370,200, little changed at −1.2% in a month, down 5.1% in three months, down 6.5% in six months, down 11.0% in a year, down 15.4% in three years and up 2.3% in five. That is 19.8% below the apartment benchmark for the Fraser Valley Board area ($461,800).

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a home in Abbotsford?
faq.a: In September 2026, a typical Abbotsford home was $701,900, with detached at $1,087,000.

faq.q: Are Abbotsford home prices rising or falling?
faq.a: Abbotsford is down 9.0% over twelve months and down 4.9% over three months.
